data.instruction: Attach the green cover to the blue main body.

env_description.cover: green, with a white grip pad, loose on the table to one side

data.instruction: Insert the orange core into the blue main body.

data.instruction: Insert the purple pin into the toy until it snaps in.

env_description.pin: purple, with a white flat handle, loose on the table
